//: Merged into <project>/.claude/settings.json by `nightshift install`. SessionStart injects and deletes handoff.txt, except in a headless `claude -p` session (a usage probe or script must not consume the briefing); Stop ends the session when <handoffDir>/NEXT_SESSION exists so shift-loop.sh starts the next one.

hooks.command: case " $(ps -o args= -p $PPID) " in *" -p "*) exit 0;; esac; f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/handoff.txt"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then jq -n --rawfile c "$f" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("# handoff.txt (auto-injected; the file has been deleted)\n\n"+$c)}}' && rm "$f"; fi
